note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this book was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the self-rendered Old Testament wording the first edition carried; the UBS credit line this file once owed is no longer owed for this work.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19), and the summary headings at the head of each chapter are quoted the same way. Where the author glosses a word inside a quotation ('(literally, be not anxious)', '(i. e. trials)', '(sell your possessions)'), the gloss stands outside the OWB pieces, or is dropped where OWB already says it (Matthew 6:31, Hebrews 13:5). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions and the author's own paraphrases left as prose, verses recast to another person, and bare citations that name a passage without quoting it.

Judgement calls: James 1:17 — OWB's «ፍጹም ስጦታ» replaces 'good gift', and Müller's next sentence follows it (decision good-gift). Proverbs 11:15 — OWB has no 'hate suretyship … be sure'; the sentence now argues from OWB's «በሰላም» and «… እጅ ለመጨባበጥ እምቢ». Proverbs 16:3 — the author's echo follows OWB's «ዕቅዶችህ». Psalm 65:2, Psalm 68:5, Hebrews 11:4 and 1 Timothy 4:8 are quoted as the OWB words that carry the phrase, with the frame adjusted. Matthew 7:7-8 (ch3 b5) is Matthew, not Luke 11:9-10: Matthew 7:11 follows it. Romans 4:20 stays self_rendered (the author's 'we stagger'), as does Nehemiah 4:6's «የመሥራት ልብ», which is Müller's prayer, not the verse.
